tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Full details for one course: what it covers, how it is assessed, the pre-course online work, what to bring, when the certificate is issued, and how long it stays current. Use it to answer whether a course meets a workplace or childcare requirement. course is the id from list_courses; a unit code suc

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Frequently asked questions and answers: which course a job needs, recognition, certificate timing, renewal, online learning, group training, cost, what to wear. Pass a topic to get the most relevant ones; omit it for all.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the nationally recognised first aid and CPR courses Australia Wide First Aid runs, with unit code (HLTAID009/011/012), price in AUD, duration, delivery (including any online pre-course learning) and renewal period. Use this to turn a need like "first aid for work" or "childcare certificate" int

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List training venues with address, grouped by state. Pass state to narrow to one state, or near (an Australian postcode or suburb the person gives you, such as "4510" or "Caboolture QLD") to get the closest venues with their distance in km. The id of a venue is the location for search_sessions.

tools.name: search_nearby_sessions
tools.description: Upcoming sessions of one course across the venues closest to a postcode or suburb, merged soonest first, with each venue's distance in km. near is required: this server can't tell where the person is, so ask them for their postcode or suburb. If a suburb exists in several states the reply lists the

tools.name: search_sessions
tools.description: Upcoming sessions of one course at one venue, soonest first: date, time, venue address, price, seats available (as the site shows them, such as "5+") and a session_id for start_booking. If the person gave a suburb or postcode rather than a venue, use search_nearby_sessions instead.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Get the link that books one place in a session found with search_sessions or search_nearby_sessions. Give the link to the person: they open it, confirm, and finish on the enrolment site, where they enter their own details and pay themselves. This tool books nothing, holds no seat and takes no person

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "start_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
